description: Unbrowse eval suite — 100 website targets across 10 categories for testing skill discovery, capture, and execution

targets.notes: Uses GraphQL internally with guest tokens. Heavy anti-bot. Requires x-csrf-token and bearer token extraction.
Voyager API with normalized JSON ($type fields). CSRF from jsessionid cookie. Trigger-intercept likely needed.
Append .json to any URL. Public, no auth needed. Rate-limited but generous.
GraphQL with rolling query hashes. Aggressive bot detection. Requires session cookies.
VM-based signature obfuscation (X-Bogus, msToken). One of the hardest targets. May need trigger-intercept.
Meta's GraphQL API. Shares patterns with Instagram. Some public data available without auth.
Well-documented public REST API. Easy target, returns clean JSON.
AT Protocol. Clean REST JSON API at public.api.bsky.app. Very easy target.
Internal resource API with JSON payloads. Requires extracting app_version and csrftoken cookie.
Well-structured REST API but requires auth token. WebSocket gateway for real-time.
Public REST API. /trending is HTML-only (no JSON endpoint), good DOM extraction test. API endpoints return clean JSON.
Clean public REST API v4. Easy target.
Registry API at registry.npmjs.org. Clean JSON. Very easy target.
Public API at api.stackexchange.com. Also has internal JSON endpoints on the SPA. Gzip-compressed responses.
/pypi/{name}/json is a perfect clean API. Search is HTML-only, good DOM test.
Public REST API. Clean JSON responses.
Clean public REST API. Very easy target.
Firebase REST API. Extremely clean. Two-step: get IDs then fetch items.
Public REST API. Clean JSON. Forem-based platform.
Internal GraphQL API. Requires extracting CSRF token from meta tags.
Primarily server-rendered HTML. Some internal JSON APIs but heavily protected. DOM extraction is the reliable path.
Mix of SSR HTML and internal JSON APIs. Search results have JSON embedded in script tags.
Internal bespoke API. Clean JSON but needs cookie/CSRF token extraction.
GraphQL via /orchestra/. Some anti-bot protection. JSON embedded in SSR pages too.
Redsky API. Requires API key extracted from page JS. Medium difficulty.
Falcor-based JSON graph API. Unique pattern - good edge case test.
Heavy anti-bot (Alibaba). Multiple internal API patterns. Aggressive fingerprinting.
Universal pattern for ALL Shopify stores. /products.json always works. Great easy baseline.
GraphQL API. Anti-bot protection. Needs session setup.
Internal AJAX API. Some anti-bot protection. IBM WebSphere-based.
Public JSON API at query2.finance.yahoo.com. Well-known, stable endpoints. Easy target.
Public API. Clean REST JSON. Very easy, but rate-limited.
Internal data-api endpoints. Different from their paid pro API. Needs cookie extraction.
Auth required. Device token + OAuth2. Internal REST API.
Mix of public and internal APIs. Screener uses POST with filter body. WebSocket for real-time data.
Internal API with versioned endpoints. Some content paywalled.
Clean internal JSON API. Next.js SPA with __NEXT_DATA__ and fetch APIs.
Public API. Clean REST JSON. Popular for DeFi/crypto.
Primarily HTML tables. Good DOM extraction test case. No JSON API.
Fully public API at api.llama.fi. Clean JSON. No auth needed.
HTML-only site (no JSON on HN itself). Use Firebase API (hackernews.firebaseio.com) or DOM extraction. Good test of both paths.
Internal GraphQL API. Some content behind metered paywall. Requires extracting operation names.
Mix of public API (limited) and internal endpoints. Hard paywall on full content.
WordPress REST API. Clean JSON. Very easy target — universal WP pattern.
Coral/Duet CMS. Internal JSON APIs available. Clean responses.
Clean REST API. Individual subdomains (e.g., newsletter.substack.com) also work.
Arc XP / Fusion CMS pattern. Internal content API.
Internal content API with URN-based routing. SSR with embedded JSON state.
WordPress REST API. Same pattern as TechCrunch.
Internal API. Some endpoints require API key from page JS.
Internal API at /api/v3/. Block-based content model. Requires auth cookies. Complex nested JSON.
Google Workspace. Complex auth (OAuth2 + session). Internal APIs differ from public Drive API.
REST API with API key + token. Well-structured but requires auth.
GraphQL API. Requires auth token. Clean, well-structured responses.
REST API. Auth required. Complex nested document model.
Clean REST API but requires API key / OAuth token.
Internal booking API. Availability check is public for scheduling links.
GraphQL API. Heavy auth and anti-bot. Complex SPA.
REST API. Auth required. Clean JSON responses.
REST API v2. Requires OAuth token. Clean, well-documented.
Internal GraphQL batch API. Anti-bot protection. Needs CSRF and session cookies.
Internal protobuf-like APIs. The official Places API is separate. Reverse-engineering Maps uses complex encoded params.
API v3 with encoded operation params. Heavy anti-bot. Requires extracting API key from page JS.
GraphQL API. Heavy anti-bot (Akamai). Complex query structures.
Internal GraphQL API with numeric IDs. Heavy anti-bot. Complex nested responses.
GraphQL at /dapi/fe/gql. Availability is the key use case.
GraphQL API. Heavy auth + session. Complex request signing.
GraphQL API. Menu data is public. Ordering requires auth.
Internal API. Complex auth token from page JS. Limited compared to Google Maps.
GraphQL API. Popular for hiking data. Some content gated.
InnerTube API. Complex protobuf-like params. Requires extracting API key and client context from page. One of the hardest targets.
Well-structured REST API. Requires OAuth token. Web player uses internal partner API too.
Public GraphQL endpoint at gql.twitch.tv. Client-ID required but can be extracted from page. Well-known operation names.
Mix of internal JSON APIs and __NEXT_DATA__. Some GraphQL at graphql.imdb.com. Amazon-owned.
Mostly HTML. Autocomplete has JSON. Popular page is DOM-only. Good hybrid test.
API at api-v2.soundcloud.com. Requires client_id extracted from page JS bundles.
Mix of internal napi JSON and HTML. Score data in ld+json schema. Good structured data extraction test.
Search API is public JSON. Lyrics page is HTML — good DOM extraction test.
Primarily SSR HTML. Some internal React JSON. Amazon-owned. Good DOM-heavy test.
Jikan API (api.jikan.moe) wraps MAL. Public, clean JSON. Easy target.
Same Voyager API as LinkedIn profiles. Normalized JSON. Requires auth.
Internal RPC/GraphQL API. Anti-bot protection. Needs session cookies.
GraphQL at /graph. Heavy anti-bot (Akamai). Requires session setup.
Clean internal API. JSON responses. Popular for tech salary research.
Formerly AngelList Talent. GraphQL API. Startup-focused job data.
Internal search API. Anti-bot protection. Rate-limited.
Public JSON API. Single endpoint returns all jobs. Very easy target.
Internal API. Tech-focused job board. Next.js SPA.
Tech job board. Mix of internal API and SSR. Some anti-bot.
Internal search API. Simpler than Indeed/Glassdoor. Less anti-bot.
Mix of REST and GraphQL. Heavy anti-bot (Incapsula). Complex encoded search params. One of the most-scraped sites.
Stingray API. Returns JSON with '}&&{' prefix (security wrapper). Need to strip prefix.
Hulk API. Internal JSON endpoints. Anti-bot protection.
Internal search API. CoStar-owned. Returns JSON.
Pure HTML, no JavaScript APIs. Classic DOM extraction target. Very stable structure.
Zillow-owned. GraphQL API. Similar patterns to Zillow but slightly simpler.
Facebook's GraphQL API. Heavy auth. Doc ID-based queries. Very complex.
Internal REST API. Clean JSON. Moderate anti-bot.
Zillow-owned rental platform. Internal API. Simpler than Zillow.
Internal REST API. Local marketplace / classifieds. Clean JSON.
Public API. Clean JSON. Multiple API versions available. Very easy target.
Internal Sun API. Requires API key from page JS. IBM-owned.
The holy grail of scraping targets. Heavy anti-bot. Mostly DOM. Some internal JSON in script tags. CAPTCHA-heavy.
DOM-based results. Less anti-bot than Google. Some JSON in page state.
Public API. Clean JSON. Very easy target.
Internal JSON API. Complex response format with pods. Requires session setup.
Same MediaWiki API as Wikipedia. Clean JSON. Easy target.
HTML-only. Very aggressive anti-bot / CAPTCHA. High-value target for researchers.
Public API at api.semanticscholar.org. Clean REST JSON. Great alternative to Google Scholar.
Public API. Requires appid key but free tier available. Clean JSON.
